//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the badge-group container. NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses. CONTAINER-ONLY: the group is a <div class="pa-badge-group [--show-all]"> whose items (badges) arrive via the text/children slot — the badge block itself is covered by badge.json, so item classes are deferred there. Models the group's own modifier (--show-all). The overflow limit + the injected 'N more'/'Collapse' toggle badges + the __toggle-* element classes are JS/data-driven runtime behaviour → cssStateClasses / cssStateElements. See ../README.md and badge.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.showAll: boolean — disable the CSS overflow limit; render all children (pa-badge-group--show-all)
propsVocabulary.content: inner badges — rendered verbatim into the container (a text slot here)

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape (snippets/badges.html — a bare <div class="pa-badge-group"> wrapping badges; +--show-all to disable the limit). Container-only: the inner badges are a text slot and the badge block is covered by badge.json, so pa-badge* item classes are intentionally deferred there. The scenarios use SNIPPET/manual mode (children provided directly) so no limit logic runs and no id/toggle badges are injected — the pure container contract. Attribute order and class-token order are normalized away; goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `produces` with {value}; capability.mjs expands + cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native.

content.note: structural — inner badges; the badge block is covered by badge.json

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-badge-group--* classes handled outside the static container contract. (none beyond --show-all, which is a feature)

cssStateElements.//: pa-badge-group__* elements the wrappers inject at runtime (the overflow toggle badges in client-side limit mode), never in the pure-container SSR shell these scenarios render.
cssStateElements.pa-badge-group__toggle-more: the injected '» N more' toggle badge (client-side limit mode, keen data-pa-badge-group-expand)
cssStateElements.pa-badge-group__toggle-collapse: the injected '« Collapse' toggle badge (client-side limit mode)
